examples.en: Every weekend my mother steams delicious dumplings.

examples.ko: 이 감자는 찌면 훨씬 더 부드러워요.
examples.en: These potatoes are much softer if you steam them.
Last night I steamed sweet potatoes and ate them.

examples.ko: 계란을 찌는 데 십 분쯤 걸려요.
examples.en: It takes about ten minutes to steam eggs.
Pour water into the pot and steam the corn.

examples.ko: 어제 호박을 쪘는데 아직 남아 있어요.
examples.en: I steamed squash yesterday and there's still some left.

explain: 만두, 감자, 고구마처럼 김으로 익힐 때 써요. 물에 넣고 끓이면 '삶다'라고 해요. '살이 찌다'와 활용이 같으니 앞말을 보고 구별하세요.

phrases.en: I steamed sweet potatoes and ate them in the morning.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for cooking sweet potatoes with steam.

explain_en: It is used when cooking with steam, such as dumplings, potatoes and sweet potatoes. Cooking food by boiling it in water is '삶다'. It conjugates the same as '살이 찌다' (gain weight), so check the word before it.
